title: Difficult Conversations Trainer
disclaimer: This is a training tool, not legal advice. The other side is an AI; any resemblance to real people is coincidental.
first_hint: Start the conversation with your first line.
limit_reached: Turn limit reached. Press “Finish” to go to the review.
err_too_long: Message is too long (800 characters max).
err_injection: This message looks like an attempt to change the trainer's rules. Please reply on topic.
err_rate: Too many requests. Wait a minute and try again.
err_llm: No reply came back. Press “Send” again.
err_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
review_empty: No conversation to review. Have the conversation first.
review_fallback: The review could not be prepared. Press “Retry review”.
rights_unverified: The legal reference for this topic is not verified yet, so we do not cite specific rules. Check them with a lawyer or a university legal clinic.
template_note: Your data stays in your browser and is not sent anywhere. This is a template: check the text before use and, if needed, show it to a lawyer.
stats_note: Anonymous aggregates only: dialogue texts are not stored.
about_how: How it works: an AI plays a pushy counterpart and you practice defending your rights. After the dialogue you get a review: what worked, your mistakes (with your own quotes), better phrasing and a written-application template.
about_limits: Limits: this is a training tool, not legal advice. The AI can be wrong. Legal facts come only from reference notes written and checked by a human; until a note is verified, article numbers and deadlines are not named.
about_sources: Sources: the official database of legal acts of Kazakhstan — adilet.zan.kz.
about_privacy: Privacy: we do not ask for names or contacts, dialogue texts are not stored, only anonymous statistics are kept.
about_help: Real help: your university's legal clinic and official state channels. Verified contacts will be added before publication.
